newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares end lower in thin market.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares end lower in thin market.

text.p: 1345 GMT -- Dutch shares end lower in thin volume after initially opening firmer, depressed by weak bonds. Second day of losses following run of six consecutive record closes. Dealers say trading dull as investors take to sidelines waiting for a new trend to emerge, but feel sentiment still broadly positive. Stork soars on news of big gasfield order win. Heineken rebounds from two days of losses.
* AEX down 2.87 points (0.47 pct) to 606.59 after opening above 611.00.
* Stork up 3.00 guilders at 58.60, Heineken rises 1.80 to 314.50.
